transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, I guess I'm here because things have been a bit tense at home lately. It's about some patterns I've been noticing. 

I know my wife says the late meetings and the little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff, but... well, for the past year, they’ve lined up too precisely to feel accidental. It just seems like there’s a private signal in them, meant to tell me something she won’t say directly. She thinks I'm reading too much into it, so she wanted me to talk to someone.
Even when your wife gives a straightforward explanation, do you still feel certain the messages are secret signals?

Yes, I do. I mean, like I was just saying, I hear her explanations, and on the surface, they sound logical. But... well, it’s been a whole year of this. The timing of those late meetings, the specific way she words things in her messages... they just line up too perfectly. 

It really doesn't feel accidental to me. Even when she tells me it's just normal office stuff, I still get this strong sense that she's sending me a private signal. It just feels like she's communicating something indirectly that she won't say out loud to my face.
Has there ever been a moment when you felt you might be mistaken about your wife’s messages being secret signals?

Honestly, not really. I mean, I try to step back and be objective, and I've tried to tell myself maybe I'm wrong. But... like I mentioned a minute ago, even though I know she insists the late meetings and those little changes in her work messages are just normal office stuff, I just can't shake it. For the past year, they’ve lined up way too precisely to feel accidental. Every time I try to doubt myself, it happens again, and it just feels like there’s a private signal in them—like they're meant to tell me something she won’t say directly.
Have you ever felt that thoughts were being put into your mind by someone or something outside you?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. My thoughts are my own. I just... I notice things that other people might overlook, like the patterns I mentioned. But nobody is putting thoughts into my head, no.
Have you ever heard voices when no one else was there?
No, I've never heard voices or anything like that. It's really just what I can see right in front of me—the messages, the schedule changes. I don't hear anything that isn't there.
Do you believe your wife is being unfaithful to you?

No, I don't think she's cheating on me. That's not... I've never suspected her of having an affair or anything like that. It doesn't feel like it's about another man. It's really just about the signals she's sending me through her work schedule and those messages. I don't believe infidelity has anything to do with it.
Outside of your concerns about your wife’s messages, do you generally find it hard to trust other people’s motives?

No, I wouldn't say that. I don't really have a hard time trusting people in general. I mean, I trust my friends, and I get along just fine with the professors and the students I work with at the university. It's not like I'm walking around suspicious of everyone's motives or anything. It's really just... strictly this specific situation with my wife and the things I've been noticing. Outside of that, everything is pretty normal.
What do you think the secret signal in your wife’s messages is meant to tell you?

I'm... I'm not entirely sure, to be honest. I mean, I know there's a pattern there—the way her shifts change, the specific words she uses when she texts me about being late—but I haven't figured out exactly what it all means yet. It's like she's trying to communicate something important, something she can't just say out loud, but the exact message... I just don't know what it is. I just know it's there.
Do other people ever tell you that your speech is hard to follow or that your thoughts seem jumbled?

No, nobody's ever said anything like that to me. I think I speak pretty clearly. I mean, when I'm teaching or leading a discussion group, the students don't seem to have any trouble following me. My thoughts aren't jumbled at all. I know exactly what I'm trying to say, and I just say it.
Have you noticed yourself becoming less emotionally expressive than you used to?

No, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed any change like that. I mean... I still feel things the exact same way I always have. I still laugh when something's funny, or get frustrated if a student isn't paying attention in the lab, or get upset when... well, you know. 

But my emotions feel completely normal to me. I'm reacting to things just like I always do, so... no, I wouldn't say I'm any less expressive than I used to be.
Do you believe your wife is able to send you these signals in a way that would be impossible by ordinary means?

No, no, nothing like that. I'm not saying she's using telepathy or... or magic or anything impossible. It's just ordinary things. She uses her phone, she sends regular text messages, she changes her shifts on the work schedule. It's all happening through completely normal channels. 

It's just the timing of it all, and the specific words she chooses, that form the pattern. But how she actually sends them? No, there's nothing impossible about it. It's just regular communication.
For how long have you been convinced that your wife’s messages contain secret signals?
I'd say it's been going on for about a year now. Yeah, roughly a year. It started right around the time she went back to working outside the home again. That's when I first started noticing it.
Did this belief about your wife’s messages start very suddenly?

I'm not really sure. I don't think it was just... one specific moment where everything suddenly changed. It was more that, around the time she went back to work, I just started seeing the patterns in what she was sending. I couldn't really tell you if it happened all at once or not, to be honest. I just know that's when I started noticing it.
Aside from this issue with your wife’s messages, has your day-to-day functioning at work and in daily life stayed about the same as usual?

Yeah, for the most part, everything else is pretty much the same. I still show up for my teaching sections, I keep up with my data analysis for my research... I still ride my bike, meet up with my friends for chess on the weekends. All of that is completely normal. 

Really, the only place this causes any trouble is just... between me and her. We get stuck in these arguments about what her work schedule really means, or why she sent a specific text at a specific time. But outside of that, no, my day-to-day life is basically the same as it's always been.
Have you ever seen things that other people could not see?

No, I haven't. I mean, I see the patterns in her messages, like I said, but it's not like I'm seeing things that aren't actually there, if that's what you're asking. I've never had any kind of... visions or anything like that.
Have you had any other beliefs that people said were strange or not true, besides this idea about your wife’s messages?

No, not really. I mean, nobody has ever mentioned anything else being strange or... off. It's really just this one thing with my wife. Everything else in my life is completely normal, and I don't have any other ideas that people think are weird.
Do you believe your wife is trying to harm you in some way?

No, definitely not. I don't think she wants to hurt me, physically or anything like that. It's not about her trying to cause me harm... it's just about her not being honest with me. But no, I don't feel unsafe around her at all.
